## Checklist

- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (the subject drives the version and the release notes)
- [ ] My code follows the project's conventions (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` / `CLAUDE.md`)
- [ ] I added or updated tests where it makes sense
- [ ] The test command from `CONTRIBUTING.md` passes locally
- [ ] `bash neon/tests/run.sh` passes (if I touched `neon/`)
- [ ] Every new user-visible string has an English and a German entry
- [ ] I updated `README.md` / `CLAUDE.md` / the relevant ADR where behaviour or setup changed
